fields.name: Limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The default is 100.

fields.name: After
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: Before
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, beginning with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `project.rate_limit`

fields.name: ID
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: Model
fields.description: The model this rate limit applies to.

fields.name: MaxImagesPer1Minute
fields.description: The maximum images per minute. Only present for relevant models.

fields.name: MaxAudioMegabytesPer1Minute
fields.description: The maximum audio megabytes per minute. Only present for relevant models.

fields.name: MaxRequestsPer1Day
fields.description: The maximum requests per day. Only present for relevant models.

fields.name: Batch1DayMaxInputTokens
fields.description: The maximum batch input tokens per day. Only present for relevant models.
